description.zh: 加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The accelerated domain names. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
- 如果域名处于非法状态或域名对应账户欠费，您将无法正常调用该接口启用加速域名。
- 单用户调用频率：30次/秒。
- 单次配置的域名数量不超过50个。
descriptions.en:
- If a domain name specified in the request is in an invalid state or your account has an overdue payment, the domain name cannot be enabled.

- Each account can call this operation up to 30 times per second.

- You can specify up to 50 domain names in each request.
